subject: Follow-up: IAM evidence & SOC 2 intake for MedAlign integration
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@medalignhealth.com>, security@medalignhealth.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: IAM evidence & SOC 2 intake for MedAlign integration

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and the specific IAM/security items we discussed so your security and procurement teams can pull them together. I merged a few asks from procurement into the list below so it’s actionable.

Key asks (what we need from MedAlign):
- SOC 2: latest Type II report (covering ingestion and hosting) + letter of attestation.
- Data residency / GDPR: confirmation of EU processing locations and any subprocessors.
- HIPAA: BAAs in place for any PHI flows (if not, flag which flows are in scope).
- SSO / SAML: metadata (IdP metadata XML), SAML endpoints, assertion attributes (email, name, groups).
- SCIM provisioning: SCIM base URL, token provisioning flow, and a sample user JSON payload.
- RBAC & admin controls: list of default roles, ability to create custom roles, and a sample access review log or process description.
- Audit log exports: example of an admin activity log (CSV or JSON) and retention period.

Next steps we recommend:
1) Please drop the SOC 2 PDF and a pointer to your security questionnaire into the shared drive link we provided (or reply with attachments).
2) For the SSO/SCIM items, we can run a short test: preferred IdP (Okta/Azure AD) and a small sample tenant for SCIM provisioning.
3) If procurement wants a plug-and-play Scope Matrix, Ben will send a short template to map out responsibilities (P1/P2).

Timeline: if we can get the SOC 2 + SAML/SCIM metadata by end-of-week (Friday 23 Jul), we’ll schedule an initial integration test the week of Jul 26 and propose an MSA draft shortly after.

Attachments: none in this message.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate with Ben and Karthik on the technical side.

—
Ava Chen
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0119

> Sam
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@medalignhealth.com>

Cc: security@medalignhealth.com, procurement@medalignhealth.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: IAM evidence & SOC 2 intake for MedAlign integration

Hi Ava — appreciate the clear list. Quick answers and what I’m attaching:

- SOC 2: attaching most recent Type II (MedAlign_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf). There’s also a short attestation letter on page 2.
- GDPR / Data residency: primary processing is us-east-1 and eu-west-1; subprocessors list is on page 8 of our SOC pack.
- HIPAA: We have BAAs with our data-hosting partner for the flows flagged as PHI; I’ve CC’d security for details.
- SSO / SAML: attaching IdP metadata XML (I’ll paste the endpoints below) and attribute map.
- SCIM: we support SCIM v2; I’ll share a sample user payload.
- RBAC: we have role templates (Admin, Manager, Auditor) and support custom roles — will include documentation.
- Audit logs: retention is 365 days; sample export limited to admin actions attached.

Attachments in this reply:
- MedAlign_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf (attachment)
- medalign_saml_metadata.xml (attachment)
- medalign_scim_sample_user.json (attachment)
- medalign_audit_admin_export.csv (attachment)

We’re also happy to provide a short demo for your engineering team for SCIM provisioning. If you can share a test Okta tenant or invite redirect/ACS URLs, we’ll coordinate.

—
Samantha Lee
Director, Partnerships | MedAlign Health
samantha.lee@medalignhealth.com

Hi Sam / Ava — good packet, thanks. I pulled the attachments into our security intake folder and created an action checklist. Short internal notes / asks:

- Confirm whether the SCIM token is per-tenant or per-org (MedAlign). If it’s per-tenant, we’ll need a short-lived token for the test tenant.
- For SAML: please confirm the NameID format you’ll assert (email vs transient). We prefer persistent/email for account mapping.
- Can security@medalign provide the contact and hour window for any live SSO cutover (to avoid auth blips during business hours)?

I’ll send over the template Scope Matrix (P1/P2 ownership) and an access-review checklist. Karthik — can you schedule a 30-minute technical sync for Thu Jul 22 (we’ll propose 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET)?

—
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Follow-up: IAM evidence & SOC 2 intake for MedAlign integration

Thanks all — quick plan from engineering for next steps and owners:

1) Integration test (owner: Karthik) — Thu Jul 29 10:00 PT: SCIM provisioning test using test token + SAML assertion test (NameID = email). We’ll validate provision, deprovision, and group sync.
2) Security review (owner: Ben) — Review SOC2 pages 6–9 for subprocessors and data flows; confirm BAA scope. Ben to share Scope Matrix by Mon Jul 26.
3) Cutover runbook (owner: Ava) — Draft rollback and monitoring checklist; include audit-log verification steps.

I attached a short Mutual Action Plan (redwood_mutual_action_plan_v1.docx) to capture the dates above and deliverables for procurement. If MedAlign can confirm the test Okta tenant invite and drop the SCIM token into a secure share, we’ll be ready to run tests on Jul 29.

If anyone needs to move the test window, call out times — security@medalignhealth.com prefers 10:00–16:00 ET as Sam mentioned.

Thanks — looking forward to the test.

—

Principal Integrations Engineer | Redwood Inference
